# Vendored i18next

- Version: **26.0.0**, MIT licence (see `LICENSE`).
- Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/i18next/-/i18next-26.0.0.tgz
- Upstream: https://github.com/i18next/i18next
- File: `dist/umd/i18next.min.js`, copied unchanged to `i18next-26.0.0.min.js`.
- SHA-256: `1ba036eee545fe8965b47120b64574f0c7d6b6be95f1792ee0b76dd9496b4341`.

This established translation library handles message lookup, interpolation and
fallback locally. No CDN, telemetry, external translation API or runtime npm
installation is used. Its licence and upstream security updates must be reviewed
when updating; verify the npm archive integrity, copy the UMD build and licence,
update every template and test reference, then run the localization checks.
